sections.title: Evergreen perennial
sections.text: A rhizomatous evergreen perennial native to China and southern Japan. Its glossy, strap-shaped leaves grow in a basal clump; a short upright spike of greenish-white flowers is followed by conspicuous red berries near the base. A garden profile gives a typical maximum height and spread of about 60 cm.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: The whole plant contains cardiac glycosides, including rhodexin A, and is poisonous if eaten. The berries are ornamental, not food; traditional medicinal use does not make home use safe.
